name: JK Agri Genetics Limited
about: JK Agri Genetics Limited researches and develops, produces, processes, and markets seeds in India and internationally. It offers field crop seeds, including cotton, bajra, jowar, maize, mustard, rice, and wheat, as well as fodder crops; and vegetables seeds, such as okra, chilli, tomato, brinjal, cucumber, bitter gourd, bottle gourd, ridge gourd, sponge gourd, pumpkin, sweet corn, watermelon, muskmelon, cabbage, cauliflower, radish, carrot, onion, coriander, beet root, green peas, beans, and marigold. The company also provides plant nutrients products, including JK NUTRESTAR PLUS, a plant growth regulator; JK POLESTAR, an immuno modulator against virus; JK ROCKSTAR, an immuno modulator against fungus; and JK IMMUN STAR. The company was formerly known as Florence Alumina Limited and changed its name to JK Agri Genetics Limited in November 2012. JK Agri Genetics Limited was founded in 1989 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
